title: Brick Kart
description: A Mario Kart-style racer where everything is built from LEGO-style bricks. Five maps (a figure-8 city, a pirate cove, a lava castle, snowy peaks and a rainbow road in space), 8 power-ups, drifting with mini-turbos, Grand Prix / Quick Race / Time Trial, and 1-4 player split-screen with controller support.
